payload.explanation: Select the installed Ghostty desktop entry before other terminal entries in the user terminal preference order.

steps: Confirm the Ghostty desktop entry is installed and usable.
Back up the user xdg-terminals.list file and place com.mitchellh.ghostty.desktop first while preserving any other entries.
Launch a terminal through xdg-terminal-exec and confirm the expected application opens.

payload.effects: Changes terminal preference order for callers using xdg-terminal-exec.
payload.rollback: Restore the previous order or remove the Ghostty entry from the user preference list.
payload.validation_plan: Preserve the previous setting, apply only after approval, then perform the final check in the procedure on the actual system.

activation.details: Apply the setting and perform its documented local check; this record does not execute it.
